title: Is Russia about to send a nuclear weapon into space? - video
summary: Amid reports that Russia might be planning to launch a satellite with a nuclear weapon onboard, Science Editor Ian Sample asks Madeleine Finlay what a nuclear detonation in space would mean for everyone back on Earth. Continue reading...
authors: Presented by Madeleine Finlay , with Ian Sample , produced by Madeleine Finlay, Ellie Sans and Joshan Chana , the executive producer was Ellie Bury
